summary: Frontend-only test of moving 'لوحة المؤسسة' and 'سجل التحويلات' from Projects Settings into Reports as tabs. All 6 requested checks passed for admin@maestroegp.com (default tenant, enterprise_enabled=true, 9 projects). (1) /reports shows reports-tab-enterprise-dashboard and reports-tab-transfers-log. (2) The enterprise tab renders enterprise-dashboard-page with no back-btn, and GET /api/enterprise/dashboard?period_days=30 returns 200; stats show 9 projects, period-select and live-status are present, and charts render. (3) The transfers tab renders transfers-log-page with no back-btn; log-project-select, log-start-date/end-date, refresh-btn, print-log-btn and transfers-log-table with 2 rows are present, and refresh works. (4) /settings/projects: open-enterprise-dashboard-btn, open-transfers-log-btn, project-dashboard-btn-* and project-transfers-btn-* all have a count of 0, and the texts لوحة المؤسسة / سجل التحويلات do not appear. add-project-btn and 9 project cards are still there. (5) A temporary admin in a non-enterprise tenant sees neither tab; the other tabs (expenses etc.) work. Switching tabs unmounts the embedded components. (6) /enterprise-dashboard and /project-transfers-log work standalone, both with in-app navigation and a direct page load, and both show back-btn.

minor.issue: The login response user object includes the 'password_vault' field (an encrypted vault blob). It should not be sent to the client. Pre-existing and outside this task.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid='refresh-btn': the Reports header refresh button and the embedded log refresh button share it, so a test selector matches both (strict mode violation).

issues: The Reports page's global project/branch/date filters stay visible above the embedded tabs but do nothing there. The dashboard uses its own period-select and the log has its own project/date filters, so there are two sets of filters (confusing). Consider hiding the global filter bar when these tabs are active.
The transfers log uses the browser's native date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar.
The page title 'إدارة المشاريع' is barely visible against the dark navy background (low contrast). Pre-existing.

action_items: Optional: rename the embedded log refresh testid (e.g. 'log-refresh-btn') to avoid duplicating the Reports header 'refresh-btn'
Optional: hide the Reports global filters when the enterprise-dashboard/transfers-log tabs are active
Optional: strip password_vault from the login/user responses
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.js showEnterpriseTabs logic is correct: (enterpriseEnabled || super_admin) && role in [super_admin, admin, general_manager, enterprise_owner]. Note that the 'owner' role from the request text is not in the list. Add it if 'owner' is a real role.
Embedded components are lazily mounted (activeTab === ...), which is good and avoids extra API calls.
Reports.js is over 5,000 lines and should be split into modules.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created the user TEST_nonent_admin@maestroegp.com in tenant 445b2f6e... and extended that tenant's expires_at, for the non-enterprise check. Both were reverted/deleted afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The environment date is 2026-10-20, so every non-default tenant's subscription has expired (login returns 'انتهى اشتراك المطعم'). Extend tenants.expires_at to test non-enterprise users. Log in by POSTing /api/auth/login, setting localStorage token/cached_user, then waiting about 14s for the splash.
